name: Charter & Course
tagline: Define your direction, navigate your journey
description:
Charter & Course is a structured approach to intentional living. Start by creating your personal 'charter' - a clear articulation of your identity, values, practices, and impact. Then use regular 'course corrections' through weekly scoreboards and quarterly reviews to stay aligned with what matters most.

This framework helps you:
- Clarify who you are at your best
- Define the code you live by
- Build consistent reflection habits
- Track progress against meaningful outcomes
- Adjust course when life throws curveballs

metadata.audience: Anyone seeking intentional living, personal accountability, and structured self-improvement
metadata.cadenceDescription: Weekly scoreboards (15-20 min), quarterly reviews (45-60 min), reset as needed

templates.name: Personal Charter: The Architect of My Life
templates.description: Define your core identity, code, practices, and impact. This is your foundational document for intentional living.
templates.guidance: Take your time with this exercise. Be honest and specific. This charter becomes the standard against which you measure yourself.
templates.unlockedMessage: Begin your journey by defining who you are at your best.

ui.introText: Your Personal Charter is the foundation of intentional living. It defines who you are, what you stand for, how you practice, and the impact you want to have.

config.content: These are the traits that define you when you're operating at your highest level. Be specific and honest about who you aspire to be consistently.

trait-dependable.label: Dependable
trait-dependable.helpText: How do you show up reliably for yourself and others?
trait-dependable.placeholder: I am the anchor. My word is iron. I do not overpromise...

config.defaultValue: I am the anchor. My word is iron. I do not overpromise. If I commit, I show up: on time and fully present. I do not flake, ghost, or make promises I cannot keep.

trait-forthright.label: Forthright
trait-forthright.helpText: How do you speak truth with courage and care?
trait-forthright.placeholder: I speak truth with courage and care...

config.defaultValue: I speak truth with courage and care. I do not avoid difficult conversations or hide behind insight. I own my feelings, mistakes, and desires without excuses or performance.

trait-generous.label: Generous
trait-generous.helpText: How do you serve those you love?
trait-generous.placeholder: I serve those I love not to earn affection...

config.defaultValue: I serve those I love not to earn affection, but because service is my language. I seek unseen needs and meet them quietly, without keeping score.

trait-disciplined.label: Disciplined
trait-disciplined.placeholder: I lead myself. I do not bargain with impulses...

config.defaultValue: I lead myself. I do not bargain with impulses; I train them. I choose what is right over what is easy, especially when no one is watching.

config.content: These are the non-negotiable principles that guide your decisions and actions. They form the moral foundation of your life.

principle-radical-responsibility.label: Radical Responsibility
principle-radical-responsibility.helpText: How do you own your emotional state and choices?

config.defaultValue: I own my emotional state. I do not make others responsible for my happiness, pain, or choices. I choose my path with eyes open and accept the cost without complaint or victimhood.

principle-integrity-dark.label: Integrity in the Dark
principle-integrity-dark.helpText: How is your character defined in private?
principle-integrity-dark.placeholder: My character is defined in private...

config.defaultValue: My character is defined in private. I uphold excellence and morality without needing an audience or applause.

principle-valuing-restraint.label: Valuing Restraint
principle-valuing-restraint.helpText: How do you practice self-control as strength?

config.defaultValue: Ability is not entitlement. Just because I can have something does not mean I should. I practice self-control as strength, not punishment. I delay gratification to build freedom, focus, and long-term power.

principle-faith-alignment.label: Faith & Alignment
principle-faith-alignment.helpText: How do you live under a higher purpose?
principle-faith-alignment.placeholder: I live under a higher purpose...

config.defaultValue: I live under a higher purpose. I align my actions with spiritual convictions and aim to be a vessel of grace, patience, steadiness, and courage in a chaotic world.

principle-service-connection.label: Service & Connection
principle-service-connection.helpText: How do you prioritize people over convenience?

config.defaultValue: I prioritize people over convenience. I build true connections through shared understanding and goals, creating and cherishing memories rather than just passing time.

config.content: These are the daily and weekly habits that build the foundation for your identity. They are the guardrails that keep you on course.

practice-physical-sovereignty.label: Physical Sovereignty
practice-physical-sovereignty.helpText: How do you honor your body?
practice-physical-sovereignty.placeholder: I honor my body through training, recovery, and mindful fueling...

config.defaultValue: I honor my body through training, recovery, and mindful fueling. I show up to the gym not for vanity, but to build resilience and energy. My routine is the guardrail that keeps me from failing when things get difficult.

practice-mental-clarity.label: Mental Clarity
practice-mental-clarity.helpText: How do you tell the truth to yourself?
practice-mental-clarity.placeholder: I journal to tell the truth to myself...

config.defaultValue: I journal to tell the truth to myself. I confront my patterns on the page, so I do not spill them onto those I love over and over.

practice-sustainable-pacing.label: Sustainable Pacing
practice-sustainable-pacing.helpText: How do you value consistency over intensity?

config.defaultValue: I value consistency over intensity. I build routines durable enough to survive bad days. Some days will be 'unimpressive,' but I keep the rhythm because routine is often the medicine that keeps me steady.

config.content: This defines how you show up for the key people and spheres in your life.

impact-for-her.label: For Her
impact-for-her.helpText: How do you show up for your partner?

config.defaultValue: I am a safe harbor... consistent, emotionally regulated, and authentic. I offer support without strings and respect the reality of her life. I want her to respect me not only for what I do for her, but for who I am on my own.

impact-for-family.label: For Family
impact-for-family.helpText: How do you show up for your family?
impact-for-family.placeholder: I am a source of stability...

config.defaultValue: I am a source of stability. I navigate chaos with a level head. I accept that I cannot control others' decisions or fix outcomes. I speak up, clearly, then release outcomes. They own their consequences, but I refuse to be resigned to inaction.

impact-for-world.label: For the World
impact-for-world.helpText: How do you engage with the world?
impact-for-world.placeholder: I live fully by engaging deeply, not superficially...

config.defaultValue: I live fully by engaging deeply, not superficially. I bring humor, depth, and authentic presence to every room. I leave rooms better than I found them... more alive, hopeful, and steady.

vow-statement.label: Your Vow
vow-statement.helpText: Write your commitment statement. This is your promise to yourself.
vow-statement.placeholder: I refuse to be a passenger in my own life...

config.defaultValue: I refuse to be a passenger in my own life. I choose Radical Responsibility. I will be steady under pressure, clean in conscience, and strong in restraint. I will build routines that survive my worst days, tell the truth before defending myself, and serve from strength. I am building a life, spirituality, and legacy I am proud to stand behind.

vow-signature.label: Signed
vow-signature.helpText: Sign your charter with your name

templates.name: Reset Protocol
templates.description: Use this when you've fallen off track and need to recalibrate. A structured way to acknowledge the slip, understand it, and get back on course.
templates.guidance: This is not about self-punishment. It's about honest assessment and recommitment. Be compassionate but truthful with yourself.
templates.unlockedMessage: Use this protocol when you need to get back on track.

ui.introText: This protocol helps you acknowledge where you've drifted, understand why, and recommit to your charter. This is not punishment - it's recalibration.

sections.title: 3. Recalibrate
